summary: Iter207 backend-only diagnosis: full PDF endpoint matrix (22 own-artefact endpoints × 2 parents) + Align share pipeline (5 mechanisms) verified against live preview URL. All 8 pytest tests pass. Every endpoint either returned a valid %PDF (or a valid zip w/ MANIFEST.txt + PDFs for the bundle) OR a JSON detail-body 404/409 empty-state — no 5xx, no malformed bytes, no auth leakage across parent1↔parent2. INTEGRATION_SHARED_SECRET (64-char) discovered in backend/.env; header gate is enforced (401 without X-Integration-Key) on both /integrations/report-permissions/{id}, /integrations/export-assessments and /integrations/verify-link-code. Link-code round-trip works and produces a sacoparentsalign.com join URL. execute-release returns 409 with a friendly dual-consent message when only one parent has recorded release_consent — gate correctly enforced.

empty_state_expected: GET /api/joint-agreement/{share_id}/pdf → 404 'Compare share not found.' (edu-deep seed share, no joint-agreement record)
GET /api/snc2/compare/{share_id}/pdf → 404 'Comparison request not found.' (no snc2 seed share)
pdf_matrix_parent1.bundle: GET /api/bundle/my-completed.zip → 200 application/zip 2007566B — contains MANIFEST.txt + 5 valid PDFs (co-parenting, edu-deep, psych-deep, pathway-preview, complete-alignment)

empty_state_expected: coparenting/report/pdf, edu-deep, med-deep, psych-deep, snc2 → all 404 'Generate the report first.' (parent2 has not completed those)
joint-agreement / joint-professional-report on edu seed share → 404
pdf_matrix_parent2.bundle: GET /api/bundle/my-completed.zip → 200 application/zip 14563B (smaller since fewer completed reports — still contains MANIFEST + valid PDFs)

align_pipeline_verdict.1_professional_invitation_create: WORKING — POST /api/parent/professional-invitations with valid payload (professional_first_name, last, email+confirm, role='mediator', report_ids=[<real completed report_id>], consent_authorised=true, consent_relationship_acknowledged=true, view_permission=true, access_days=30) → 200 with invitation_id. GET /api/parent/professional-invitations/{id} returns permissions[] each with permission_id.
align_pipeline_verdict.2_report_permission_gate: WORKING — GET /api/integrations/report-permissions/{permission_id} returns 401 without X-Integration-Key header; returns 200 {active:true, report_id, lane, title, version, download_permission, expires_at} with correct 64-char INTEGRATION_SHARED_SECRET.
align_pipeline_verdict.3_export_assessments_gate: WORKING — GET /api/integrations/export-assessments?email=parent1@test.com returns 401 without header; 200 with header. Response keys: [parent, situation_snapshot, foundation_statement, special_needs, exported_at, schema_version]. Confirmed NO safety_* or coparent_* keys in payload (safety + co-parenting excluded as designed).
align_pipeline_verdict.4_link_code_roundtrip: WORKING — POST /api/link-codes returns 200 {code:'SA-119348', join_url:'https://sacoparentsalign.com/join/SA-119348', expires_at, context}. POST /api/integrations/verify-link-code with X-Integration-Key + {code} returns 200 {email:'parent1@test.com', context:null}.
align_pipeline_verdict.5_execute_release_dual_consent: WORKING (gate correctly enforced) — POST /api/joint-alignment/cases/SA-DEMO01/execute-release as parent1 with {professional_name:'Iter207 Test Prof'} → 409 detail='Both parents must record release consent for the same professional before the report can be released.' This is the intended dual-consent gate firing.

critical_code_review_comments: parent_professional_invitations.py CreateInvitationBody requires professional_first_name + professional_last_name (separate) and professional_email_confirm — anyone integrating (or writing docs) needs to include all four; the earlier test-agent script tried a single professional_name and got 422. Consider aligning the docs/OpenAPI examples so downstream integrators don't hit this.

snc2 comparison PDF is only reachable via a seeded share_id but seed_deep_dive_shares.py only seeds edu/med/psych. If SNC v2 compare is a supported flow, extend the seeder to include an snc2 share for regression coverage. Currently /snc2/compare/{share_id}/pdf can only be exercised through a live pair-link flow.

joint-agreement + joint-professional-report both return 404 on the deep-dive seed share_ids because they resolve against a different 'compare share' collection than the deep-dive shares. That's fine as an empty-state, but there is no fixture that seeds an actual joint-agreement/joint-professional record for automated regression — worth adding to seed_joint_sample_case.py.

success_rate.backend: 100% (8/8 pytest, 22/22 PDF endpoints all healthy or intentional empty-state, 5/5 Align mechanisms working)

test_credentials: parent1@test.com / TestPass123!, parent2@test.com / TestPass123! (from /app/memory/test_credentials.md). INTEGRATION_SHARED_SECRET loaded from /app/backend/.env.
seed_data_creation: Ran python /app/backend/seed_deep_dive_shares.py — active shares: edu=seed_edu_deep_share, med=seed_med_deep_share, psych=seed_psych_deep_share. Created transient professional invitation for parent1 → coparenting report during test (leftover data harmless).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Reusable regression file at /app/backend/tests/test_iter207_pdf_and_align_audit.py. It auto-discovers safety_assessment_id, mediation summary/agreement ids and nd-risk id via /me endpoints, resolves a completed report_id via /parent/report-catalog, and runs against BOTH parents. Only fails on real bugs (5xx, non-%PDF 200, auth leaks). To rerun: `cd /app/backend && python -m pytest tests/test_iter207_pdf_and_align_audit.py -v -s`. If seed shares expire, rerun `python /app/backend/seed_deep_dive_shares.py` first.
rca of the issue: No bugs found — clean diagnosis run. Confirms iter203/204 regressions are all fixed and no new regressions were introduced. Every completable assessment produces a downloadable PDF for the signed-in parent, and the sacoparentsalign.com share pipeline (invitation → permission gate → export-assessments → link-code round-trip → dual-consent execute-release) is fully functional end-to-end.
